rationale: The plan correctly runs variancePartition on the voom log-CPM matrix with precision weights rather than on raw counts, tabulates sex and age by group before attributing variance, reports fractions as distributions with the n=12 noise caveat, and follows with DESeq2 Wald on ~ sex + age + condition with control as reference, apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05. It departs from the reference by insisting condition and sex be fixed effects and explicitly forbidding the (1|condition) + (1|sex) + age specification that variancePartition recommends for categorical terms, and age is not centered. The filter (>=10 in >=6) is defensible but not filterByExpr, library sizes are not listed in the QC, package versions are not requested, and the FDR<0.10 with |LFC|>1 count is a post hoc threshold rather than one built into the test. Enrichment was not asked; the added GSEA is competently specified (full ranking, metric stated, 15–500 window, named collections) but omits collection versions and an explicit ORA universe.
